prompt:
Game map background for a 2D top-down RPG, 1536x1024 landscape (3:2), filling the whole frame edge to edge, no border.

CAMERA: high-angle bird's-eye view looking down at about 50 degrees, orthographic-looking like a classic JRPG / Stardew-style town map: NO vanishing point, NO perspective convergence, all vertical building edges parallel and pointing straight up the image, ground plane seen almost from above. Building fronts are visible as short facades along the top and side edges; we see their roofs foreshortened. Consistent scale: a doorway is about 60 px wide and 100 px tall, a person would be about 90 px tall (but draw NO people).

STYLE: hand-painted cartoon illustration in exactly the painting style of the attached reference map (clean dark ink outlines on every shape, soft painterly cel shading, natural proportions, rich but slightly muted colours, no chibi, no pixel art, no 3D render, no photo). Mood and palette from the attached stage backdrop: Cyberpunk underground city in the year 2086, night-blue shadows, rusty metal, corrugated sheet metal, cables, steam, wet ground with reflections, neon light in hot pink, cyan and violet, warm yellow window light as accent. Readable game art: the walkable ground is large, flat, clearly lit and uncluttered; props sit at the edges; strong value contrast between floor (walkable) and walls/props (blocking).

The attached images are references for painting style, camera angle, scale and colour ONLY. Do not copy their buildings or layout and do not draw any characters.

STRICT: no people, no figures, no animals, no silhouettes of persons, no readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no watermarks, no signature, no frame, no UI.

LOCATION: Follow the layout of the attached grey blockout sketch: light = walkable ground, dark = buildings/blocking, cyan = exits. The last attached image is only the floor-plan sketch, not its look (ignore its labels, they are not part of the picture). "Blades Turmbüro", the luxurious CEO office at the very top of a glass corporate tower in the upper city, interior seen from above, cut-away walls on the top edge only, floor fills most of the image: dark polished marble floor with thin gold inlay lines and a big white fur rug in the middle, a large open, calm walkable area.
TOP WALL, the most eye-catching spot: a full-width floor-to-ceiling panoramic window showing the night city skyline far below, glittering lights, a violet glowing tower spire.
In front of the window, TOP CENTER: a huge desk made entirely of glass with a golden desk lamp and a single glowing tablet, behind it a tall black leather executive chair with gold studs.
TOP LEFT: a flipchart on a stand covered with abstract hand-drawn diagrams - a circle city map with arrows, crosses and a crown symbol (no letters).
LEFT WALL: a big gold-framed painting of an abstract golden crown on red, slightly tilted (it hides a wall safe); lower left a chrome coat stand with several golden hooks, all empty.
RIGHT WALL: a mirrored champagne bar with bottles in ice buckets, rows of crystal glasses and a small brass bar cart.
CENTER, in front of the desk: two plump violet velvet visitor armchairs facing the desk.
RIGHT SIDE lower: a slim black pillar with a floating cyan holographic emitter ring on top (an AI terminal); BOTTOM RIGHT: a glass display cabinet with spare golden cane knobs on red velvet cushions.
BOTTOM CENTER: golden elevator doors in the bottom wall (private elevator, the way out).
Small stuff at the edges only: a tall vase with white orchids, a golden globe, a marble bust shape without a face, small spotlights.
Light: night, indoor, warm golden lamp light mixed with cool blue city glow from the window, violet accents. Vain, rich, theatrical. IMPORTANT: this room will be cropped to 4:3 - the outer ~90 px at the far left and far right edges are only plain dark wall filler; keep all room content inside the central area, exactly as in the sketch.
